name: What information should I prepare before getting a quote for custom finish carpentry?

mainEntity.name: What information should I prepare before getting a quote for custom finish carpentry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before requesting a quote for custom finish carpentry, it is helpful to gather a few pieces of information. Consider preparing a clear idea of the specific pieces you want, such as built-in bookshelves, unique crown molding, or a custom mantel. Having photos of styles you like, approximate dimensions of the space, and any preferred wood types or finishes will help us understand your vision. This preparation ensures a more accurate initial discussion and quote, helping us align on your project goals from the start.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before a quote, prepare details like desired pieces, style photos, approximate dimensions, and preferred wood types to help define your vision.
